notes.title: Demo Update 0.3
notes.content: [p][b]Demo Patch Notes: Update 0.3[/b][/p][p]Improvements:[/p][list][*][p]Added friends invite feature for multiplayer sessions[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced matchmaking for better connectivity[/p][/*][*][p]Improved melee animations and hit detection[/p][/*][/list][p]Fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Interaction with the Game Over screen is now possible[/p][/*][*][p]Slide is now only allowed while running[/p][/*][*][p]Instantly leave the lobby without repeated attempts[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues where the pause menu would not close[/p][/*][*][p]All settings now apply correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Reload advice is now removed when switching weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Spectator UI is now removing correctly after respawn[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Important Notice[/b][/p][p]There is currently an issue with the Steam subsystem in the engine, which causes multiplayer to not work correctly.[/p][p]I am actively working on a solution and will provide an update as soon as the issue is resolved.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Hotfix 0.2
notes.content: [p][b]Demo Patch Notes: Initial Hotfix 0.2[/b][/p][p]A Small patch to address immediate feedback and bugs.[/p][list][*][p]Prevented zombies from spawning after a wave.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Drake-12 texture.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected revive widget display.[/p][/*][*][p]Ensured turret widget displays properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled reloading while sprinting.[/p][/*][*][p]Added game credits.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated M1911 shoot sound.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved scalability setting reset.[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled back button in player lobby.[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Go to Menu" in Pause Settings.[/p][/*][/list]
